notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'DEVIL TIMES FIVE'
notes.content:
[b]DEVIL TIMES FIVE[/b] (1974)
[list]
[*] Susan loves fire
[*] Moe loves to play
[*] Brian acts like a soldier
[*] David wants to be famous
[*] Hannah is an albino nun in training
[/list]
What do they all have in common ? [u]They are psychotic killers ![/u]
